ethics_review.scope: Documented Lambda MSK role permissions for disabled-only mapping admission: CreateNetworkInterface on exact-owned subnets/security group and regional account ENIs conditioned on exact-owned VPC, DeleteNetworkInterface conditioned on same VPC; exact cluster/topic/group IAM access and ListScramSecrets. No broad managed policy, no direct ENI API calls, no Lambda invocation, no enabling mappings, no data; native cleanup retires any owned ENIs. Prior one-cluster/time/cost/cleanup bounds unchanged.
